cases.name: ranks most wins first and omits players without counted games
breaks equal wins by fewer losses
head-to-head does not separate players on the same wins and losses
the name only orders players inside a shared position
three players on the same wins and losses share one position and the next takes the next number (1, 2, 2, 2, 3)
two players on 4-2 share position 1 whoever won between them, and the next player is numbered 2 (1, 1, 2, 2, 3)
excludes substitution partials and invalid results
a substitute given the game by the incoming choice has the win and the game
a credited outgoing player has the loss with the side they played on
an invalid match gives nobody anything
standings show the adjusted games with wins and losses as recorded
a shared position sorts accented and mixed-case names by name (ICU default locale)
six players tied on record: accented, unaccented and lowercase names
winners tied: Ángel, Angel, ångel and Zed order
losers tied: the same names order the same way
names equal apart from case keep their input order
identical names keep their input order
names with digits, spaces and hyphens
a name starting with a lowercase letter against capitals
non-latin letters beside latin ones
